sources.title: 排列、參數、集中度、溫度與充分性手工推導
sources.details:
permutation: For fixed model weights and candidate set C, score s_c=f(state, question, meaning(c)) contains no list position. A permutation pi changes the score vector only to P_pi s; softmax(P_pi s)=P_pi softmax(s) because the sum of exponentials is unchanged. The row-specific attention, normalization, FFN and score do not mix batch rows. Identical maximum lengths and no dropout in this example make the CPU comparison exact. The conclusion is about reordering the same candidates, not removing or adding candidates.
parameters: 144*64 + 128*64 + 2*(128 + (64*192+192) + (64*64+64) + 128 + (64*128+128) + (128*64+64)) + 128 + (64+1) = 84545. The embedding count includes the fixed PAD row; total parameters means numel(), not only nonzero gradients.
concentration: c=(n*pmax-1)/(n-1) is 0 for uniform pmax=1/n, 1 for a point mass, and does not consult the gold label. A wrong argmax can therefore have c approximately 1. Using the preserved weather logits at T=.25 gives p(boxes)=.9999999999996012 and c=.9999999999995215 despite gold=none.
temperature: For T>0, dividing every candidate score by T preserves score order. Odds p_i/p_j=exp((s_i-s_j)/T) become more extreme when T decreases below 1. This can reduce CE for confident correct cases and increase the penalty of confident errors; the saved raw wording-shift logits exhibit the latter. No general calibration guarantee follows from calibration-split optimization.
exercise: Given the stated closed exercise contract, the visible rule suffices to answer the condition-document question (yes). A case identifier plus that rule does not determine whether case42 has authorization (information sufficiency=no). Adding authorization status=no fully determines the factual authorization question, so information sufficiency becomes yes while the authorization result remains no. These are manually defined labels, not predictions from the old finite-character model.
